The patient's presentation is best explained by severe viral pneumonia due to COVID-19. Unvaccinated older age, progression to ARDS requiring intubation and proning, and acute kidney failure all support severe COVID-19. Bacterial pneumonia with sepsis and non-infectious ARDS are unlikely because the viral etiology is confirmed and no bacterial pathogen or non-infectious cause has been identified. The evidence strongly converges on severe COVID-19 pneumonia as the cause of the patient's respiratory failure.
